title: A pane can be marked as the workspace's agent scratch pane
body:
An agent in a workspace can reach that workspace's panes over MCP (`focus`, `panes`, `code.*` in `src/mcp.rs`), but has no place of its own to show Jack something. Jack's target is a decade-aware preview program in decade-apps that shows code previews, plots, images, diagrams and markdown. That program is a black box from decade's side and is not part of this issue.

## Proposal

- Jack marks one pane per workspace as its scratch pane, from the Ctrl bar.
- An MCP tool lets an agent start a decade-aware program from decade-apps, by name, in the scratch pane, and send it content. decade refuses any other program and refuses when the workspace has no scratch pane.
- The scratch mark is saved with the workspace.

## Out of scope

Letting an agent ask for a scratch pane to be created, with Jack confirming, is a later idea.

## Open

- How decade knows which programs are decade-aware: a list in decade's config, or what decade-apps installs.
- The MCP tool's name and arguments.
